headlines.title: Microsoft services hit by major outage across the world
headlines.description: A widespread outage continued to hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook on Friday, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts.

headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair with suspected Chinese spy
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships.

headlines.title: Home Heating Costs Set to Surge: Here’s How to Save
headlines.description: As millions get set to face the coldest air of the season so far, they’ll be cranking up the heat — and they may want to brace for higher costs. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with ways to lower those winter bills, including installing smart thermostats, getting furnaces checked now, reversing ceiling fans, and more.

headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after reports of extramarital relationships
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid reports of multiple extramarital relationships, including one with a woman who reports to him and another with an alleged Chinese spy. NBC News’ Jared Perlo reports on the latest details surrounding the resignation and what it could mean for the company’s future.

headlines.title: How Markets Are Reacting to Nvidia CEO’s Scandals
headlines.description: The growing fallout from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reported inappropriate relationships is having an impact on Wall Street, with the stock down more than 24 percent over the last month and the company losing over $1.5 trillion in value from its peak. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY with how the scandals are affecting everyday people whose 401(k)s may be tied to Nvidia.

headlines.title: How to Save on Pet Expenses: Vet Visits, Medicines, Food, More
headlines.description: The cost of owning a pet is skyrocketing with average vet claims now 32% more expensive than 2020 and prices for pet food and treats up 20%, forcing some pet owners to make heartbreaking decisions. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with strategies to save, including negotiating vet bills, staying on top of preventative care and even filling some pet medications at human pharmacies.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Nvidia stock falls after Huang resigns, weighing on broader market
headlines.description: Stocks declined at the opening bell on news that Jensen Huang, one of the most important executives in the AI boom, resigned as CEO of Nvidia.

headlines.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
headlines.description: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.

headlines.title: Nvidia board meets over CEO’s future as chip giant reels from China spy scandal
headlines.description: The New York Times reported that Huang had a relationship with an Nvidia executive following reports that he’d had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Record credit card balances, fewer trips to McDonald’s: More signs of strain ahead of the holidays
headlines.description: Federal data shows savings rates have dipped below 4% of total income, well below pre-pandemic levels, revealing a fraying financial safety cushion.

headlines.title: Stanley Zabar, co-owner of iconic NYC food shop, dies at 94
headlines.description: He and his brother were tasked with carrying on their parents’ legacy through smoked fish and home-roasted coffee.
